stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 14 of the story “The Antique Shop.”

“Customers are taking a piece of history with them, something that brings back a happy memory or sparks their imagination.”

Which lines from the poem “Don’t Go Into the Library” contain a SIMILAR idea?

options.label: A
options.text: You know what will happen./It’s like a pet store or a bakery— (lines 3–4)

options.label: B
options.text: And those no-nonsense, all muscle/Greyhounds and Dobermans, (lines 8–9)

options.label: C
options.text: Cuddly when they’re young,/But then the first page is turned. (lines 11–12)

options.label: D
options.text: You may not come out/The same person who went in. (lines 23–24)

visual_elements: Inset box with the quoted sentence: “Customers are taking a piece of history with them, something that brings back a happy memory or sparks their imagination.”
